title: Refactor lint orchestration and introduce rule provenance tracking
author: Priya Natarajan
release_notes: Refactors lint orchestration, adds rule provenance metadata, and introduces a sparse-test scheduler to reduce CI cost for lint-only churn. No runtime API changes.
description:
Motivation: Our monolithic lint runner has been a large contributor to CI minutes and noisy signal when rule ownership or rule-surface changes. This PR refactors the lint orchestration layer to separate rule evaluation from runner execution and attaches 'provenance' metadata to rules so we can target fixes, notifications, and owners more accurately. It also introduces a sparse-test scheduler that avoids running full integration/test suites on lint-only or rule-doc changes and coalesces consecutive lint-only pushes into a single CI run when feasible.

Summary of changes:
- Introduce RULE_PROVENANCE manifest (ci/lint-orchestrator/provenance.yaml) that records rule id, owner, last-changed commit, and risk score
- Replace legacy lint entrypoint with a lightweight orchestrator (ci/lint-orchestrator/main.go) that computes minimal job graph and delegates execution to existing runners
- Add sparse-test-scheduler that performs fast impact analysis and schedules only the required test shards for low-risk changes
- Add coalescer to .github/actions/commit-coalescer to merge frequent lint-only pushes into a single queued run (opt-in by label)
- Bump dev deps: eslint-plugin-typescript 5.8.0 -> 6.0.1, @redwood/lint-shim 1.3.2 -> 1.4.0 (minor; includes provenance extractor)
- Docs: new guidance and troubleshooting for rule ownership and how to update provenance
- Tests: unit tests for orchestrator, scheduler, and provenance extractor

Checklists:
- [x] design doc linked (ENG-3245)
- [x] unit tests added for orchestrator and scheduler
- [x] integration smoke run against staging allocator
- [x] shared config migrations scripted (ci/lint-orchestrator/migrate-provenance.sh)

Performance/impact:
- Measured against a 30-day sample of PRs: median lint-only CI minutes reduced by ~48% and median end-to-end feedback time improved from ~9m to ~5m for lint-only changes
- Sparse-scheduler avoided full-test runs for ~37% of non-functional-change PRs in the sample

Rollout plan:
- Feature gated (env REDWOOD_LINT_ORCH=false by default)
- Opt-in via label "ci:orchestrate-lint" for first week and compare telemetry
- After verification, flip default and migrate provenance using scripted job. Migration details and rollback instructions are in ci/lint-orchestrator/README.md
